title: Speakeasy JS - Redbean: Actually Portable Executable Web Server (Justine Tunney)
summary: Justine Tunney presents Redbean, a web server distributed as a single actually portable executable that runs on multiple operating systems. It embeds Lua, SQLite and MbedTLS in a fork-based server.
why: The author and others link it as the definitive explanation of redbean and the APE toolchain, including its performance claims.

categories.name: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages

quote.text: If you're interested in learning more, this talk from 2021 is fascinating
